processors.description: Map claude_code.llm_request spans to GenAI semconv (chat)

dql.script:
fieldsAdd gen_ai.operation.name = "chat"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.provider.name = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.system = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.request.model = model
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.response.model = model
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.usage.input_tokens = toLong(input_tokens)
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.usage.output_tokens = toLong(output_tokens)
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.usage.total_tokens = coalesce(toLong(input_tokens), 0) + coalesce(toLong(output_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.conversation.id = session.id

processors.description: Map claude_code.interaction spans to GenAI semconv (invoke_agent)

dql.script:
fieldsAdd gen_ai.operation.name = "invoke_agent"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.provider.name = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.system = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.agent.name = "Claude Code"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.agent.id = "claude-code"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.conversation.id = session.id
| fieldsAdd tmp_prompt_escaped = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(user_prompt, "\\", "\\\\"), "\"", "\\\""), "\n", "\\n")
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.input.messages = concat("[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"", tmp_prompt_escaped, "\"}]")
| fieldsRemove tmp_prompt_escaped

processors.description: Map claude_code.tool spans to GenAI semconv (execute_tool)

dql.script:
fieldsAdd gen_ai.operation.name = "execute_tool"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.provider.name = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.system = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.tool.name = tool_name
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.conversation.id = session.id

processors.description: Correlate the claude_code.tool.execution and claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user child spans to the conversation. Deliberately sets no gen_ai.operation.name: these are sub-phases of the parent claude_code.tool span, and typing them as execute_tool would count every tool call three times.

dql.script:
fieldsAdd gen_ai.provider.name = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.system = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.conversation.id = session.id
